name: Crystalline silicon PV (PERC, TOPCon, HJT)
principle: Silicon wafers convert sunlight to DC electricity; the cell structure sets efficiency. PERC is the mature cell, TOPCon and heterojunction (HJT/SHJ) are the current upgrades. NREL's 2024 baseline models a 100 MWdc (74.6 MWac) one-axis tracked plant with bifacial modules and costs it at $1.56/WAC in 2023.

performance.metric: capacity factor, AC, one-axis tracking, ILR 1.34
performance.basis: 2021 first-year range from lowest to best solar resource class

source.note: NREL Annual Technology Baseline 2024, utility-scale PV, read 25 October 2026
